comparison.objective: Lower a free-rolling rover from a ledge onto a lower track one axle at a time.
comparison.physical_skill: Supported lowering and rolling-load control across a height transition.
comparison.success_condition: The rover reaches the lower track without dropping or being lifted clear; detailed numeric thresholds are absent.
comparison.reason: Tests controlled support of a vehicle over an edge, not localized component fracture or recovery.
